verdict.rationale: Pigment documents built-in agents users can delegate work to: the Modeler Agent builds, maintains, and optimizes planning models from natural-language intent, and the Analyst Agent monitors the business and builds reports from conversations. Agent Connectors let these agents pull context from systems like Notion, Google Drive, and Slack, with admin-scoped access. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of agent task scope and limits (evidence is marketing one-liners), independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
